df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns\ncategorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*60)\nprint(\"第二阶段：数值列全面统计分析\")\nprint(\"=\"*60)\n\nstat_results = {}\nfor col in numeric_cols:\n    stats = {\n        '均值': df[col].mean(),\n        '中位数': df[col].median(),\n        '标准差': df[col].std(),\n        '最小值': df[col].min(),\n        '最大值':
